name: research-methods-mcp
description: Research methods for AI assistants: study design guidance, R and Python code, and citations.
long_description: Grounds Claude in methodological texts on causal inference, econometrics, experimental design, marketing research, credit scoring, and artificial intelligence. The server recommends designs for a research question, retrieves the relevant sections, returns runnable R and Python code, and formats references in APA, Chicago, MLA, Harvard, BibTeX, or RIS. It runs locally and requires no account or API key.

tools.name: choose_method
tools.description: Recommend methods for a research question, with assumptions, R and Python packages, and readings.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read a section with its code, link, and citation.

tools.name: get_code
tools.description: Get runnable R, Python, or Julia code for a task.

tools.name: cite
tools.description: Format references in APA, Chicago, MLA, Harvard, BibTeX, or RIS.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List the works in the library: textbooks, an R package, and research articles.
